title: Referrals
description: Invite other clinics and earn free days on your subscription. Rewards are credited when they pay their first month.
how_step_1_body: Send the link or code to another clinic.
how_step_2_body: They use your code when activating their account.
how_step_3_body: When they pay their first month, days are added to your next renewal.
rewards_hint: The higher the plan they choose, the more days you earn.
